stance_basis: letter and attached memo argue regulations must allow state/local flexibility and preserve open-until-closed policy for Wyoming
summary: Paul H. Westedt, Director of the Wyoming Recreation Commission, submitted a letter and attached inter-office memo commenting on the Draft Environmental Statement for Executive Order 11644. He and his staff argued that Wyoming does not have a significant ORV problem, that regulations must be flexible enough to accommodate state and local conditions, and that an 'open until closed' policy is preferable to a 'closed until open' approach. Their detailed page-by-page comments on the draft EIS reflect conditional support for the regulatory effort provided it is adapted to Wyoming's unique circumstances.
complaint_summary: Westedt transmits the Wyoming Recreation Commission's evaluation and comments on the draft EIS for Executive Order 11644 pertaining to ORV use on public lands.

statement.text:
Attached please find our evaluation and comments with respect to the draft environmental statement for the proposed implementation of Executive Order 11644, pertaining to the use of off-road vehicles on the public lands. We greatly appreciate an opportunity to comment on this draft.
Sincerely,
for Paul H. Westedt
Director
PHW:1c1 Encl.
